common.authoritative: The Spanish version of these texts is the authoritative one. Translations are provided for convenience; in case of discrepancy, the Spanish text prevails.

sections.heading: 1. Who runs this site
body: Under article 10 of Spanish Law 34/2002 on information society services and electronic commerce, the details of the owner of this website are:
Holder: {holder}. Tax ID: {taxId}. Address: {address}. Contact email: {email}.

sections.heading: 2. Purpose
body: Ascenda is a platform for browsing a worldwide catalogue of mountains and logging ascents. Browsing the catalogue is open to anyone; logging ascents requires an account.
Using the site makes you a user and implies acceptance of this legal notice and of the terms of use.

sections.heading: 3. Intellectual property
body: The code, design and graphic elements of the site belong to the holder. Mountain catalogue data comes from Wikidata and is used under its licence. Peak photographs come from Wikimedia Commons and keep their authors' licence and attribution.
Content uploaded by each user — photographs, route notes and ascent data — remains theirs. The licence granted to Ascenda to display it is set out in the terms of use.

sections.heading: 4. Disclaimer
body: Catalogue information comes from external sources and may contain errors or omissions. Ascenda does not guarantee its accuracy or currency.

Mountains are dangerous. The information on this site is indicative and is no substitute for preparation, training or your own judgement. The holder is not liable for decisions made on the basis of it.
The holder is not responsible for content published by users nor for third-party sites linked from here.

sections.heading: 5. Governing law
body: This legal notice is governed by Spanish law. Any dispute will be heard by the courts designated by the applicable consumer protection rules.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
body: Controller: {holder}. Tax ID: {taxId}. Address: {address}. Email: {email}.

sections.heading: 2. What we process and why
body: Account: email address, username and password, the latter always stored irreversibly hashed. Purpose: to create and maintain your account. Legal basis: performance of the contract (GDPR art. 6.1.b).
Profile: display name, profile address, bio, country and profile picture, if you fill them in. Purpose: to show your public climber profile. Legal basis: performance of the contract.

Ascents: date, companions, route notes, conditions, visibility and photographs. Purpose: to record and display your ascents according to the visibility you choose. Legal basis: performance of the contract.

Security: we record failed sign-in attempts and email dispatches, but we store only a cryptographic digest of the identifier and the IP address, never their value. Purpose: to prevent abuse and brute force. Legal basis: legitimate interest (art. 6.1.f).

sections.heading: 3. Who else sees your data
body: Cloudinary: hosts and delivers your photographs. Before uploading we re-encode them and strip their metadata, including the GPS coordinates summit photos usually carry.
Domain email provider: sends confirmation and password recovery messages.
{mapProvider}: when the map loads, your browser requests tiles from their servers, which receive your IP address. That is why the map does not load until you consent.
Wikimedia Commons: when a mountain photograph is shown, your browser requests it from their servers.

Have I Been Pwned: when you choose a password we check it against known breaches. We only send the first five characters of the password's cryptographic digest, which cannot be used to reconstruct it or to identify you.
We do not sell your data and we do not share it for advertising.

sections.heading: 4. How long we keep it
body: Your account and your content, for as long as the account is active.
Security records, thirty days. Closed sessions, ninety days. Confirmation and recovery links already used or expired, thirty days.

When you close your account we delete your profile, your ascents and your photographs, and replace your email with an irreversible pseudonym. We keep that pseudonymised row indefinitely for one specific reason: to stop anyone else from signing up with your email or your username.

sections.heading: 5. Your rights
body: You can access and download your data as a file from Account settings, correct it from your profile, and erase it by closing your account. You can also restrict who sees your content by marking your profile or each ascent as private.
If you believe we are not handling your rights properly, you may complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

sections.heading: 6. Minors
body: Ascenda is not aimed at anyone under 14. By signing up you declare that you are at least that age, the threshold set by article 7 of Spanish Organic Law 3/2018.

sections.heading: 1. What we use and why
body: Ascenda uses no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies. There is no profiling and no third party following you across sites.
The cookies we do use are strictly necessary for the site to work, or store a preference you chose yourself, so they are exempt from the prior consent duty of article 22.2 of the Spanish LSSI.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies and storage in use
body: ascenda_at — first party, technical. Keeps you signed in. Expires after 15 minutes.
ascenda_rt — first party, technical. Renews your session without retyping your password. Expires after 30 days.
NEXT_LOCALE — first party, preference. Remembers the language you chose. Expires after a year.
ascenda_cc — first party, technical. Remembers your decision about the third-party map. Expires after 6 months.
ascenda-preferences — browser local storage. Remembers whether you prefer your ascents as cards or as a table.
ascenda-email-confirmation — browser local storage. Remembers when you may request the confirmation email again.

sections.heading: 3. The third-party map
body: The map uses {mapProvider} tiles. Loading it makes your browser connect to servers outside Ascenda, which receive your IP address. That is not a cookie, but it is a disclosure to a third party, so we ask first.
If you decline, the site still works: where the map would go you get a button to load it just that once.

sections.heading: 4. Changing your mind
body: At any time, from the «Cookie preferences» link in the footer. Withdrawing permission is as easy as granting it.
You can also delete cookies from your browser settings. Deleting the technical ones will sign you out.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance
body: These terms govern the use of Ascenda. Creating an account is an express acceptance of them. If you disagree, do not use the service.
We may amend them; if a change is significant we will tell you and ask you to accept them again.

sections.heading: 2. Your account
body: You must be at least 14 and provide accurate details. Your username is your public identity and appears in your profile address.
You are responsible for your password and for what happens in your account. Tell us if you suspect unauthorised access.
You can close your account whenever you want. Closing it deletes your content, but does not free your email or your username: nobody will be able to sign up with them afterwards.

sections.heading: 3. Your content
body: You keep ownership of everything you upload: photographs, notes and ascent data.

By publishing it you grant us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free and revocable licence, limited to hosting, reproducing and displaying that content within Ascenda with the visibility you chose. We will not use it for anything else nor share it for advertising.
Deleting a piece of content, or closing your account, ends that licence.
You warrant that you have the right to upload what you upload and that it infringes neither third-party rights nor the privacy of anyone shown.

sections.heading: 4. Prohibited conduct
body: Publishing unlawful or defamatory content, content inciting hatred, or content infringing third-party rights.
Impersonating someone else or creating accounts automatically.
Attempting to access other people's accounts, probing the security of the service or degrading it with mass requests.
Systematically extracting content to reuse it outside Ascenda.

sections.heading: 5. Suspension
body: We may suspend or close an account that breaches these terms. Where reasonable we will warn you first and explain why.

sections.heading: 6. Availability and liability
body: Ascenda is provided «as is». We aim to keep it available and its data correct, but we do not guarantee that there will be no interruptions or errors.
Mountain information is indicative and is no substitute for preparation or your own judgement in mountain activities.

sections.heading: 7. Governing law
body: These terms are governed by Spanish law, without prejudice to the rights granted to users by consumer protection rules.

banner.title: Cookies and the third-party map
banner.body: We use no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies. We only need your permission for the map, which loads from {mapProvider} servers and lets them see your IP address.
banner.preferencesBody: Choose what may load. You can change this whenever you want from the footer.
banner.technicalBody: Keep you signed in, remember your language and your interface choices. They cannot be switched off.
banner.mapsBody: Loads the map tiles. Their servers receive your IP address.
